Meet Patchpaw the Calico, the sanctuary cat for State Street's SPYx.
Patchpaw is a little calico whose coat is a quilt of many small patches…
Inspired by State Street Global Advisors.
Not launched yet — adopt it soon.
https://catcoinsanctuary.com/#cat=PATCHPAW
#catcoin #CatsOfX

Why Patchpaw looks the way it does: SPYx is an index fund that holds hundreds of companies, so her calico coat is made of many small patches, no two alike.
Proof: https://www.ssga.com/us/en/intermediary/etfs/state-street-spdr-sp-500-etf-trust-spy
